The Nigeria Democratic Congress presidential candidate, Peter Obi, has congratulated Nigeria’s U-17 women’s national team, the Flamingos, following their triumph at the FIFA U-17 Women’s World Cup in Morocco.
Obi praised the young footballers for their resilience, talent, hard work and dedication, saying their achievement had brought immense joy and pride to the country.
In a congratulatory message on his X handle on Saturday, he commended the team for raising Nigeria’s flag high on the international stage and earning a special place in the hearts of Nigerians.
He described the team’s performance as a testament to the potential of Nigerian youths, noting that their determination and commitment had made the nation proud.
“Thank you for raising our flag high and bringing immense joy to our nation. Your remarkable talent, resilience, hard work and dedication have earned you a special place in the hearts of Nigerians,” Obi said.
He added: “You have made our nation proud, and we truly appreciate your outstanding efforts. Congratulations, champions!”
Obi concluded his message with his familiar optimism about the country’s future, declaring: “A new Nigeria is possible.”
